name: Andy Ogles
summary:
William Andrew Ogles IV ( OH-gəlz; born June 18, 1971) is an American politician and business owner serving as the U.S. representative for Tennessee's 5th congressional district since 2023. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as the mayor of Maury County, Tennessee, from 2018 to 2022.
Ogles has taken strongly conservative positions and been described by media as being on the far-right of the political spectrum.
